title: Data Mixing Optimization for Supervised Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Yuan Li, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric Xing
paper_type_zh: 监督微调数据混合优化研究
best_for_zh: 为昂贵的多领域监督微调选择领域比例的读者。
one_line: A fitted transfer-and-scaling loss model selects SFT domain weights for a fixed token budget.
拟合迁移—缩放损失模型，在固定词元预算下选择监督微调的领域权重。
why: It turns data-source allocation into an explicit, auditable optimization decision.
inclusion_reason: It optimizes how source-labeled instruction records are allocated to supervised fine-tuning under a fixed budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A general-purpose SFT model is trained from instruction-response data spanning domains such as instruction following, mathematics, and code. The total token budget is limited, so assigning more data to one domain necessarily reduces another. Exhaustively testing the simplex of possible mixture weights is expensive, and pre-training mixture rules may not transfer because SFT starts from a particular pretrained model and has different scaling and cross-domain-transfer behavior.

This paper asks how to select domain weights for a fixed SFT budget while minimizing held-out validation loss across the intended domains. The data object is a source-labeled instruction-response example, and the training decision is the number of tokens sampled from each domain. It does not score individual answers for correctness; it models how changing a domain's allocation affects a model after fine-tuning.

通用监督微调模型由覆盖指令遵循、数学和代码等领域的指令—回复数据训练而来。总词元预算有限，给一个领域分配更多数据必然减少另一个领域。穷举可能混合权重的单纯形代价很高，而预训练混合规则也未必能迁移，因为监督微调从特定预训练模型开始，并具有不同的缩放和跨域迁移行为。

本文追问如何在固定监督微调预算下选择领域权重，同时最小化预期领域上的留出验证损失。数据对象是带来源标签的指令—回复样本，训练决策是从每个领域抽取多少词元。它不为单条回答的正确性打分，而是建模改变一个领域的分配会如何影响微调后的模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper represents the value of a domain by a fitted validation-loss curve. For a target domain, its effective data is the amount of its own data plus an estimated transfer contribution from all other domains; the resulting effective size is inserted into a fine-tuning scaling law. This separates two effects that a static mixture hides: diminishing returns from more in-domain tokens and transfer from the rest of the mixture.

After fitting five parameters per domain from small perturbation runs, the method solves for weights on the probability simplex that minimize the sum of estimated per-domain validation losses. Equal domain weighting in the objective targets a broadly capable model, while user-selected domain multipliers can instead target a specialty. The proposed mixture is therefore an explicit optimization result tied to the data budget, evaluation domains, and base model, rather than a fixed heuristic.

论文用拟合的验证损失曲线表示一个领域的价值。对于目标领域，其有效数据量等于自身数据量加上从其他所有领域估计得到的迁移贡献；得到的有效规模再进入监督微调缩放律。这区分了静态混合所隐藏的两种效应：增加领域内词元的边际递减收益，以及来自其余混合数据的迁移。

在小规模扰动运行中为每个领域拟合五个参数后，方法在概率单纯形上求解权重，使估计的逐领域验证损失之和最小。目标中对领域等权，旨在训练能力广泛的模型；用户选择的领域乘数则可改为面向专长。因而，所提混合是与数据预算、评测领域和基础模型绑定的显式优化结果，而非固定启发式规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method begins with a small balanced SFT run, then perturbs one domain at a time through four alternative data-size ratios while holding the remaining domains fixed. It records validation loss after every run and fits a domain-specific formula with Huber loss and a constrained trust-region procedure. The formula contains a scaling term for the selected domain and an effective-data-from-transfer term for the other domains, with constraints preventing the transfer estimate from exceeding the available out-of-domain data.

For a target budget, the fitted curves are summed and optimized with sequential least-squares programming under nonnegative weights that add to one. Controlled experiments use instruction following, math, and code, with ratios one-half, one-third, two, and three around a 660,000-token unit size. The paper also reweights six skill domains of Tulu3 and source-defined domains in Orca, and evaluates model-specific results for Llama3.1-8B, Llama3.1-70B, and Qwen2.5-32B.

方法先进行小规模均衡的监督微调，然后在保持其余领域不变时，按四种替代数据规模比例逐个扰动领域。它记录每次运行后的验证损失，并以 Huber 损失和带约束的信赖域过程拟合领域特定公式。该公式包含所选领域的缩放项，以及其他领域带来的有效数据迁移项；约束防止迁移估计超过可用的领域外数据。

对于目标预算，拟合曲线被求和，并在非负且和为一的权重约束下用序列最小二乘规划优化。受控实验使用指令遵循、数学和代码，在 660,000 词元单位规模附近采用二分之一、三分之一、二和三的比例。论文还重加权 Tulu3 的六种技能领域和 Orca 的按来源定义领域，并报告 Llama3.1-8B、Llama3.1-70B 和 Qwen2.5-32B 的模型特定结果。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
In the controlled three-domain study, weights predicted from small perturbation experiments approach the best mixtures found by exhaustive grid search over 21 combinations. The abstract reports that the predicted mixture's per-domain loss is on average only 0.66% above the best per-domain loss achieved by grid search. This is the direct evidence for the claimed extrapolation: the fitted loss surface is useful enough to select a full-budget mixture without retraining every possible weight combination.

For Tulu3 reweighting, the reported average validation perplexity improves from 2.162 to 2.150 for Llama3.1-8B and from 2.127 to 2.080 for Llama3.1-70B; Qwen2.5-32B improves from 2.165 to 2.133. On downstream Tulu3 tasks, the learned mixture gives averages of 50.4 and 63.8 for the two Llama models, compared with 50.1 and 61.1 for the original mixture. The paper also reports a counterexample: on Orca, held-out loss and downstream performance need not agree, so validation alignment is a condition of the method rather than a universal guarantee.

在受控的三领域研究中，从小规模扰动实验预测的权重接近对 21 种组合进行穷举网格搜索所找到的最佳混合。摘要报告，预测混合的逐领域损失平均仅比网格搜索获得的最佳逐领域损失高 0.66%。这构成对所称外推能力的直接证据：拟合的损失曲面足以选择全预算混合，而无需重新训练每一种可能的权重组合。

对于 Tulu3 重加权，报告的平均验证困惑度对 Llama3.1-8B 从 2.162 改善到 2.150，对 Llama3.1-70B 从 2.127 改善到 2.080；Qwen2.5-32B 从 2.165 改善到 2.133。在下游 Tulu3 任务上，学习得到的混合为两个 Llama 模型给出 50.4 和 63.8 的平均分，而原始混合为 50.1 和 61.1。论文还报告一个反例：在 Orca 上，留出损失和下游表现未必一致，因此验证对齐是方法的条件，而不是普遍保证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier data-mixing work emphasized pre-training, used proxy-model weights, or treated mixture loss with formulas that do not explicitly represent SFT scaling and cross-domain transfer. This paper moves the decision to SFT and defines an effective data quantity for each target domain: its own tokens plus a fitted contribution transferred from the remaining domains. The optimizer then selects weights that minimize predicted validation loss under a finite token budget.

The new contribution is not simply fitting a curve or using SLSQP. It is the coupled loss parameterization, the perturbation protocol used to identify it, and the balanced multi-domain objective that avoids assigning all budget to a single apparently useful source. The paper's Tulu3 and Orca comparison is also part of the contribution: it shows that a good loss model is only useful when validation domains correspond to the downstream capabilities one wants to preserve.

更早的数据混合工作侧重预训练、使用代理模型权重，或用没有明确表示监督微调缩放和跨域迁移的公式处理混合损失。本文将决策移到监督微调，并为每个目标领域定义有效数据量：自身词元加上从其余领域拟合出的贡献。随后，优化器在有限词元预算下选择使预测验证损失最小的权重。

新的贡献不只是拟合曲线或使用序列最小二乘规划。它是耦合的损失参数化、用于识别该参数化的扰动协议，以及避免将所有预算分给单一表面有用来源的平衡多领域目标。Tulu3 和 Orca 的比较也是贡献的一部分：它显示好的损失模型只有在验证领域对应希望保留的下游能力时才有用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method depends on validation sets that represent the desired downstream domains. Its own Orca results show that lower held-out loss can fail to improve downstream averages when the source-defined domains and evaluation tasks are misaligned. It operates on coarse domains, while a source such as FLAN may internally contain many heterogeneous tasks; repeated sampling of a small favored domain can also cause overfitting, which the paper links to an IFEval drop. The paper releases its PMLR record but does not declare a dedicated implementation or new standalone dataset, so its perturbation, fitting, and data-processing choices must be reconstructed and upstream dataset terms checked independently.

该方法依赖能代表目标下游领域的验证集。其 Orca 结果表明，当按来源定义的领域与评测任务不对齐时，更低的留出损失可能无法改善下游平均表现。它在粗粒度领域上运行，而 FLAN 这类来源内部可能包含许多异质任务；反复抽样被偏好的小领域也会导致过拟合，论文将其与 IFEval 的下降联系起来。论文发布了 PMLR 记录，但没有声明专用实现或新的独立数据集，因此需要重建扰动、拟合和数据处理选择，并独立核验上游数据集条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work before a costly SFT run when data can be partitioned into meaningful domains and each domain has a matching held-out validation slice. First run small, controlled perturbations; record token budgets, ratios, base model, and all validation losses; then fit the transfer-and-scaling curves and optimize weights for the actual budget. Compare the resulting mixture with original, equal-token, equal-instance, and repeated random baselines, and report both per-domain and downstream performance so an average loss gain cannot hide damage to a required capability.
当数据能划分为有意义领域，且每个领域都有匹配的留出验证切片时，可在昂贵的监督微调运行前使用本文。应先运行小规模受控扰动，记录词元预算、比例、基础模型和全部验证损失，再拟合迁移—缩放曲线并为实际预算优化权重。应将得到的混合与原始、等词元、等实例和重复随机基线比较，并报告逐领域和下游表现，从而避免平均损失收益掩盖对必需能力的损害。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The main lesson is that data mixture is a model- and budget-dependent optimization variable, not a property of a dataset collection alone. The method's signal is validation loss at the domain level, and its usefulness rests on whether that loss is a valid proxy for the downstream contract. Read the near-grid-search result as evidence for efficient mixture search in the controlled setting, then read the Orca mismatch and IFEval exception as boundaries: domain definition, validation construction, repeated sampling, and target task alignment all determine whether the chosen weights are trustworthy.
主要启示是，数据混合是依赖模型和预算的优化变量，而不只是数据集集合的属性。方法的信号是领域级验证损失，其有用性取决于该损失是否是下游契约的有效代理。应把接近网格搜索的结果理解为受控设置中高效搜索混合的证据，再把 Orca 的不匹配和 IFEval 的例外理解为边界：领域定义、验证构造、重复抽样和目标任务对齐共同决定所选权重是否可信。
